name: messaging.drafts
description: List cloud chat-composer drafts visible to the signed-in desktop account.

name: messaging.chat-draft
description: Read cloud drafts matching a native chat or thread. Uses the authoritative all-drafts entity and filters it locally before bounding output.

parameters.name: chatId
parameters.description: Native desktop chat identifier; the wrapper does not establish a public oc_ format.

parameters.name: threadId
parameters.description: Native desktop thread identifier; no format is inferred.

evidence.snippet: FETCH_CHAT_INPUT_DRAFT cache uses entity.drafts and draft chatId/threadId metadata

name: messaging.reply-draft
description: Read cloud drafts matching a native reply message. Uses the authoritative all-drafts entity and filters it locally before bounding output.

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: Native desktop message identifier; the wrapper does not establish a public om_ format.

evidence.snippet: FETCH_MESSAGE_REPLY_DRAFT consumes draft/entity.drafts keyed by messageId

name: messaging.message-metadata
description: Read one message's native identifier, chat/thread linkage, and sender identifier without projecting message body content.

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: Native desktop message identifier; no public-ID format is inferred.

name: messaging.chat-metadata
description: Read one native chat's identity, type, name, owner, and member count without projecting messages or membership records.

parameters.name: chatId
parameters.description: Native desktop chat identifier; no public-ID format is inferred.

name: messaging.inbox-chats
description: List recent inbox chat cards as native chat IDs, names, types, and unread counts. The first-page cursor follows the desktop feed reducer; count is required because its UI derives it from viewport height. No preview snippets or message content are returned.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Positive number of feed cards to request; the desktop UI derives this from its viewport height.

name: messaging.p2p-chat
description: Resolve the native P2P chat ID already associated with one native desktop user identifier. This is read-only and does not create a chat.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Native desktop user identifier; no public-ID format is inferred.

name: messaging.recent-message-match
description: Search the most recent native chat page for one exact text from one native sender, returning matching native message IDs only. Unrelated message bodies are not projected.

parameters.name: chatId
parameters.description: Native desktop chat identifier.

parameters.name: senderId
parameters.description: Native desktop sender identifier.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Exact message text to match; it is used only for local filtering and is never returned.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Recent page size, default 20 as in the shipped history wrapper.

name: messaging.favorites
description: List Favorites from the desktop client's Favorites view using its cursor pagination schema.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of Favorites requested; the traced UI defaults to 15.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Native Favorites pagination cursor; the traced initial UI request uses 0.

name: messaging.favorite-detail
description: Read one Favorite record by its native desktop identifier.

parameters.name: favoriteId
parameters.description: Native desktop Favorite identifier; no public-ID format is inferred.

evidence.snippet: const t=[e]; ... const{entity:e}=await Zr.R1(t); return n=ti({entities:e,favoritesIds:t,...})

name: messaging.shortcuts
description: List desktop feed shortcut structural metadata using the UI's local-cache request strategy. A shortcut channel is not assumed to be a chat.

evidence.snippet: async function g(e={syncDataStrategy:l.lDc.LOCAL},t){let s=await (0,r.px)(o.xVQ,e,{parentContextId:t}); return ... s.shortcuts ...}

name: messaging.feed-folder
description: Read the desktop feed-folder setting and its used folder identifiers.

name: messaging.scheduled-chat
description: Read the scheduled-message item for a chat or chat thread. The default force-server strategy follows the UI's authoritative second refresh; strategy 1 preserves its local-cache first pass.

parameters.name: chatId
parameters.description: Native desktop chat identifier.

parameters.name: rootId
parameters.description: Native root-message identifier for a chat thread.

parameters.name: strategy
parameters.description: Native sync strategy: 1 local cache or 3 force-server; defaults to 3.

evidence.snippet: let s=a.messageItems,i=s?.[0]; let e=a.entity ... scheduleMessage ... quasiScheduleMessage ... scheduleTime ... status

name: messaging.scheduled-thread
description: Read the scheduled-message item for a reply thread. The default force-server strategy follows the UI's authoritative second refresh; strategy 1 preserves its local-cache first pass.

parameters.name: chatId
parameters.description: Native desktop chat identifier.

parameters.name: threadId
parameters.description: Native desktop thread identifier.

parameters.name: strategy
parameters.description: Native sync strategy: 1 local cache or 3 force-server; defaults to 3.
